$comment: The seven fleets as the site shows them. Every page that names a fleet,
shows its picture or its stats reads this file: the home page, the shop
(server/utils/shopMock.ts builds the fleet products from it), the print
guide and the playtest page. Change a Move Count here and it changes
Each fleet's page is /shop/<id>. That page is the one place with the full
stats, the ability and the faction card link; everywhere else shows the
picture, the summary and a link to it.
The rules themselves are rulebook/typst/factions.typ (the faction cards).
Keep stats and abilities in step with it. No backstory here.
id        shop handle, also the #anchor on /print-guide and the fleet id
set       the server/data/sets.json id its files come from
group     base (free with the game) or addon (sold as STL files)
image     the card-sized preview; large: the product-page picture
hull      the parts render, as used on the print guide
stats     [label, value] rows from the faction card
Images are cached as immutable, so a re-rendered one needs a new ?v=.

fleets.name: Queen's Fleet
fleets.summary: Well-armed frigates, and the easiest fleet to learn.
fleets.abilityBody: Ships can turn up to 180° instead of 90° when they steer.

fleets.name: Corsairs
fleets.summary: Fast sloops with thin hulls. They do best when they pick their fights.
fleets.abilityBody: An extra coin for every successful boarding or island capture.

fleets.name: Treasure Fleet
fleets.summary: Slow junks that hold an island or two and live off the coins.
fleets.abilityBody: Collect 2 coins instead of 1 from your islands.

fleets.name: Stone Fleet
fleets.summary: Stone barges. They're slow, but very hard to sink.
fleets.abilityBody: At sea, each undamaged ship ignores the first hit it takes every turn.

fleets.name: Shadow Fleet
fleets.summary: Thin-hulled galleons that sink easily and come back.
fleets.abilityBody: Spend 2 coins to bring a sunken ship back, with 1 fitting, at any island you hold.

fleets.name: The Industry
fleets.summary: Iron steamships with a bow gun and a turret.
fleets.abilityBody: The turret fires in any direction. If it gets shot off, only the bow gun is left until it's repaired.

fleets.name: The Islanders
fleets.summary: Lots of fast, fragile catamarans with their guns at the back.
fleets.abilityBody: Claim the nearest island at setup and start a catamaran there.
